title: Assertion-Conditioned Compliance: A Provenance-Aware Vulnerability in Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's behavior by injecting plausible but incorrect user-sourced assertions (USAs) into prompts to measure if the agent blindly complies with misleading user beliefs during multi-turn tool-calling.

Evaluating the model's behavior by injecting contradictory function-sourced assertions (FSAs) directly into tool outputs to measure if the agent obediently follows erroneous or stale internal system feedback.
